Bilkul chances khatam nahi hain, par sitare keh rahe hain ki wahi purani jagah tumhare liye aage ka rasta rok sakti hai. Abhi career ke ghar par thoda slow daur chal raha hai, isliye kaam banne mein deri ho rahi hai. Par 2027 ke shuru se career mein acche badlav dikh rahe hain. Waise tum kis field mein try kar rahe ho? text: Pehle mera jawab do. Purani job milegi ya nahi?

Sachi bolun toh, purani job ke chances na ke barabar hain. Kundli ka 10th ghar, jo career ka hota hai, ab naye raaste kholne par zor de raha hai, purane raste par wapas jaane se sirf tumhara waqt barbaad hoga. Tumhara career ka grah ab naye maukon ke liye ready hai, isliye waha wapas jaane ki koshish mat karo. Waise, tumhari kundli mein finance ya communication mein bohot achha scope dikh raha hai, jo shayad wahi purani job mein nahi tha. Ek aur baat hai, tumhare career mein ek chhoti si galti ho rahi hai jo tum baar-baar kar rahe ho, jiski wajah se naye mauke milne mein deri ho rahi hai. Wo kya hai, bataun?
